### Load annotation file

- Load ensembl annotation gtf

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

require("rtracklayer")
annotation_gtf <- "/nemo/lab/patanir/home/users/palk/Genomes/ENSEMBL_hg38/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.104.chr_patch_hapl_scaff.gtf"
annotation_ranges <- import.gff2(annotation_gtf)

```

- Load significantly differentially enriched proteins

```{r}

significantly_affected_proteins_df <- read.csv(file.path(output_dir, "05-pairwise-grouped-significantly-affected-proteins.csv"))

```

### 5.0 Perform gene set enrichment

- Map Entrez IDs to Ensembl IDs

```{r}

unconnected <- T
k <- 1
while(unconnected){
    message(k)
    mart <- tryCatch(useEnsembl("ensembl","hsapiens_gene_ensembl", version = "104"), error = function(cond){
        return(NA)
    })
    if("Mart" %in% class(mart)){
        unconnected <- F
        break
    }
    k <- k+1
}

get_ids_df <- getBM(c("entrezgene_id","ensembl_gene_id","uniprotswissprot", 
    "description","hgnc_symbol", "peptide"), "hgnc_symbol", 
        unique(significantly_affected_proteins_df$protein_name), mart)

saveRDS(object = get_ids_df, file = file.path(save_dir, "06-01-hgnc-to-uniprot-mapping-df.rds"))

unique_name_to_id_df <- unique(get_ids_df[get_ids_df$uniprotswissprot != "",c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol", "uniprotswissprot")])

```

- STRING enrichment

```{r}


require("STRINGdb")
require("ggrepel")

string_db <- STRINGdb$new(version = "11.5", species = 9606, score_threshold = 200, input_directory = tmp_dir)
proteins_mapped_to_string_db <- string_db$map(significantly_affected_proteins_df, "protein_name", removeUnmappedRows = TRUE)

id_split <- split(proteins_mapped_to_string_db$STRING_id, proteins_mapped_to_string_db$direction_group)

all_enrichment_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(id_split), function(x){
    enrichment_df <- string_db$get_enrichment(id_split[[x]])    
    enrichment_df$direction_group <- x
    return(enrichment_df)
}))



significant_enrichment_df <- all_enrichment_df[all_enrichment_df$fdr < 0.05,]
significant_enrichment_df$gene_ratio <- significant_enrichment_df$number_of_genes / significant_enrichment_df$number_of_genes_in_background

write.csv(x = significant_enrichment_df, file = file.path(output_dir, "07-significantly-enriched-terms-from-string.csv"))
unique(significant_enrichment_df$category)
#  [1] "COMPARTMENTS"      "Process"           "Component"
#  [4] "Function"          "TISSUES"           "Keyword"
#  [7] "KEGG"              "SMART"             "InterPro"
# [10] "Pfam"              "RCTM"              "WikiPathways"
# [13] "HPO"               "NetworkNeighborAL"

compartment_df <- significant_enrichment_df[significant_enrichment_df$category == "COMPARTMENTS",] 
compartment_df$description[order(compartment_df$gene_ratio, decreasing = T)]


component_df <- significant_enrichment_df[significant_enrichment_df$fdr < 0.05 & significant_enrichment_df$category == "Component",]
compartment_df <- significant_enrichment_df[significant_enrichment_df$fdr < 0.05 & significant_enrichment_df$category == "COMPARTMENTS",]
hpo_df <- significant_enrichment_df[significant_enrichment_df$fdr < 0.05 & significant_enrichment_df$category == "HPO",]
smart_df <- significant_enrichment_df[significant_enrichment_df$fdr < 0.05 & significant_enrichment_df$category == "SMART",]
pfam_df <- significant_enrichment_df[significant_enrichment_df$fdr < 0.05 & significant_enrichment_df$category == "Pfam",]
keyword_df <- significant_enrichment_df[significant_enrichment_df$fdr < 0.05 & significant_enrichment_df$category == "Keyword",]

keyword_df$description[order(keyword_df$gene_ratio, decreasing = T)]

```

- Plot STRING compartment enrichment

```{r}

require(ggbeeswarm)

my_theme <- theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
    linetype = "dashed",
    size = 0.2))

max_gene_ratio <- vapply(split(compartment_df$gene_ratio, compartment_df$description), max, 1)

Colours <- c("down->up" = "#FB3640", "up->down" = "#247BA0",
    "down->down" = "#72A3C0", "up->up" = "#E0777D")

compartment_df$description <- factor(compartment_df$description, levels = names(max_gene_ratio)[order(max_gene_ratio, decreasing = F)])

ThePlot <- ggplot(compartment_df, aes(x = gene_ratio, y = description))
# ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_vline(xintercept = 0.1, linetype = "dashed")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_quasirandom(aes(fill = direction_group), colour = "#000000", shape = 21, size = 1.5)
ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_x_continuous("gene ratio")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_y_discrete("Enriched compartments (fdr < 0.05)")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_fill_manual("Direction groups", values = Colours)
ThePlot <- ThePlot + theme_bw()
ThePlot <- ThePlot + ggtitle("Compartment enrichment from STRING")
# ThePlot <- ThePlot + facet_grid(. ~ sig_group, scales = "free")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + my_theme
ggsave(width = 10, height = 10, file = file.path(plot_dir, "03-06-plot-enriched-compartments-from-STRING.pdf"), ThePlot)

```
